candidate_ideas.statement: Establish the precise numerical range needed to deduce CKgP for M_{6,5}, then use the applicable cycle-class theorem to prove W_{24}H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) is a sum of Q(-12).
Prove the residual identification W_5 isomorphic to omega_C^2(-D) on the free balanced tetragonal locus and consequently L isomorphic to omega_C(-D).
Construct the rank-drop locus globally and prove that its balanced free-pencil incidence has a dimension-17 component of pure codimension 4.
Prove that every hyperelliptic, trigonal, plane-quintic, unbalanced, nonreduced-support, and closure stratum has the asserted dimension and codimension, including stabilizer and finite-map behavior.
Compute the monodromy of the relevant Hurwitz and divisor covers and prove directly that W_{18}H^{18} of the dominant rank-drop stratum is a sum of Q(-9).
Give a concrete geometric presentation of the complementary CE-surjective open U and prove CKgP, or an equivalent lowest-weight Tate statement, for that specific open.
After controlling every support stratum and the open complement, use localization and strictness to prove that W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) is a sum of Q(-13).

established_facts.evidence: The displayed calculations are 3*6-3+6=21, 2*21-16=26, 26-2*21=-16, and -13+21=8, applied to H^{BM}_k(X)=H^{2d-k}(X)(d).
established_facts.statement: The smooth stack M_{6,6} has complex dimension 21, and Poincare duality identifies W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) with W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21); under this twist Q(-13) becomes Q(8).

established_facts.evidence: Deligne's lowest-weight edge-image theorem for a smooth open stack and a smooth proper compactification gives W_kH^k(X)=im(H^k(overline X)->H^k(X)); proper smooth cohomology in degree 26 is pure of weight 26.
established_facts.statement: The lowest-weight subspace W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) is the image of H^{26}(overline M_{6,6};Q) in H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q), and it is pure of weight 26.

established_facts.evidence: The punctured-curve fibre has cohomology only in degrees 0 and 1. The constant row contributes H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 because vcd(M_{6,5})=25, while the only possible differential adjacent to E_2^{25,1} has a zero source or target.
established_facts.statement: For the forgetful morphism p:M_{6,6}->M_{6,5}, there is an isomorphism H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=H^{25}(M_{6,5};R^1p_*Q), compatible with mixed Hodge structures and W_{26}.

established_facts.evidence: The residue sequence for a genus-6 curve with five punctures has a rank-(5-1)=4 Tate quotient of weight 2 and the rank-2g=12 closed-curve summand of weight 1.
established_facts.statement: The punctured-curve local system fits into 0->H->R^1p_*Q->Q(-1)^4->0, where H is the rank-12 weight-1 local system of the universal closed genus-6 curve.

established_facts.evidence: For a pure coefficient system of weight w, H^p has weights at least p+w. Thus H^{25} with Q(-1) coefficients has weights at least 27, while H^{24} has weights at least 26; strictness of mixed Hodge structures applies to the coefficient long exact sequence.
established_facts.statement: The weight floor gives W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};Q(-1)^4)=0 and reduces W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};R^1p_*Q) to a quotient of W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};H), with kernel a subquotient of (W_{24}H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q)(-1))^4.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004, Lemma 10.6 explicitly supplies the negative-twist convention and the degree formula.
established_facts.statement: With W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P1}(-f))|_C, one has deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f; at g=6 this gives deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_4)=20.

established_facts.evidence: The two obstruction line bundles have degrees -4 and 0. A negative-degree line bundle has no section, and a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth connected projective curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: For an effective divisor Gamma of degree 6, the f=4 obstruction vanishes, while the f=5 obstruction is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: Since deg(W_5)=16 and deg(omega_C)=10, deg(L)=6. Riemann-Roch gives chi(L)=6+1-6=1, so h^0(L)=1+h^1(L).
established_facts.statement: The line bundle L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} has degree 6 and satisfies chi(L)=1, hence h^0(L) is at least 1.

established_facts.evidence: A reduced degree-six divisor has exactly 6! orderings, and the free permutation action is etale over the pairwise-distinct locus; the reduced-support condition is open.
established_facts.statement: Over the reduced-support open of a relative degree-six linear system, ordering the six distinct support points gives a finite etale S_6-torsor.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A pure weight-26 Hodge structure may have off-diagonal Hodge types (p,q) with p+q=26; purity alone does not force type (13,13).
invalid_steps.statement: Purity of weight 26 by itself implies that W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) is Tate.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A source-dimension count does not determine generic fibre dimension, image dimension, component purity, stabilizers, or behavior under closure.
invalid_steps.statement: The parameter count 15+2=17 proves that the rank-drop incidence maps generically finitely onto a pure codimension-4 component.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finite pushforward of the constant sheaf can contain nontrivial local systems whose cohomology has non-Tate Hodge summands; mixed-Tate cohomology of the base does not control those coefficient systems.
invalid_steps.statement: A finite morphism from a Hurwitz stack to a mixed-Tate open in M_{0,18} makes the Hurwitz stack mixed Tate.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Averaging only projects an already understood representation onto its invariant direct summand; it supplies no Tate-purity statement for the covering space or its nontrivial isotypic local systems.
invalid_steps.statement: Rational averaging over S_6 establishes Tate purity of the ordered finite etale cover.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: CKgP has no blanket preservation theorem under arbitrary opens or finite maps; a precise presentation and applicable localization or descent theorem are required.
invalid_steps.statement: Arbitrary open immersions and finite morphisms automatically preserve CKgP, so the asserted operations prove CKgP for U.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The Gysin degree shift fixes which cohomology groups can contribute but does not determine their Hodge type or the intervening differentials; each stratum and coefficient system must be identified and controlled.
invalid_steps.statement: Unnamed lower-dimensional strata contribute only zero or Tate classes to degree-26 cohomology with supports.
